shown.message:
Outline rev. 25 was already pushed and covers `story-repo`#10, so I commented on #10 and closed it.

`paper-repo` dev bf889e1 matches rev. 25. It also closes `paper-repo`#23: the main text now says the block reading does not replicate on the original cells. And it covers what I asked for in `paper-repo`#24:
- the true curvature is marked infeasible
- κ* is at the grid floor
- the lean arm is back in the appendix as a negative (0.877 at 31×)
- the cost of a feasible M is not measured

`paper-repo`#24 is still open, and `report` can close it. `story-repo`#2 stays open.
